SkillCAT：面向 LLM 智能体的对比式、评估增强与拓扑感知技能自我演化SkillCAT: Contrastive, Assessment-Augmented and Topology-Aware
Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents

摘要Abstract

面向 LLM 智能体的技能自我演化方法旨在将执行轨迹转化为可复用的技能文档。然而，当前流程通常针对每项任务仅从单条轨迹中提取技能补丁，不加区分地合并补丁，并在推理时加载整个技能语料库。这些做法会导致证据提取不可靠、低质量甚至有害的技能修改不断累积，以及因技能内容无关或相互冲突而低效使用上下文。我们提出 SkillCAT，这一框架将该过程分解为三个阶段。(1) 对比因果提取（Contrastive Causal Extraction，CCE）为每项任务采样多条轨迹，并对比同一任务的成功/失败轨迹对，以找出能够解释结果差异的证据。(2) 评估增强演化（Assessment-Augmented Evolution，AAE）在源任务克隆上重放每个候选补丁，仅保留不会损害任务结果的补丁，然后分层合并保留的补丁。(3) 拓扑感知任务执行（Topology-Aware Task Execution，TTE）将演化后的技能编译为可路由的子技能拓扑，使推理时只加载与任务相关的能力节点。我们在广泛使用的智能体基准上评估 SkillCAT，包括 SpreadsheetBench、WikiTableQuestions 和 DocVQA，并进一步评估跨模型及分布外泛化能力。在这些设置中，与初始技能相比，SkillCAT 的平均得分最高提升 49.69%，展现出可靠且有效的技能演化效果。Skill self-evolution methods for LLM agents aim to turn execution trajectories into reusable skill documents. However, current pipelines typically derive skill patches from a single trajectory per task, merge them indiscriminately, and load the entire skill corpus during inference. These choices lead to unreliable evidence extraction, the accumulation of low-quality or even harmful skill edits, and inefficient use of context due to irrelevant or conflicting skill content. We propose SkillCAT, a framework that decomposes this process into three stages. (1) Contrastive Causal Extraction (CCE) samples multiple trajectories per task and contrasts same-task success/failure pairs to find the evidence that explains outcome differences. (2) Assessment-Augmented Evolution (AAE) replays each candidate patch on source-task clones, retains only those that do not damage task outcomes, and then merges the retained patches hierarchically. (3) Topology-Aware Task Execution (TTE) compiles the evolved skills into routable sub-skill topologies, so that inference loads only task-relevant capability nodes. We evaluate SkillCAT on widely-used agent benchmarks, including SpreadsheetBench, WikiTableQuestions, and DocVQA, and further assess cross-model and out-of-distribution generalization. Across these settings, SkillCAT improves the average score over the initial skill by up to 49.69%, demonstrating reliable and effective skill evolution.

引言Introduction

基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体已成为解决复杂交互任务的一种通用范式（Wang et al. 2024；Yao et al. 2023；Schick et al. 2023；Wang et al. 2023）。为支持这种能力，外部技能文档提供了一种重要机制，可在执行时注入可复用的流程、工具使用知识和任务经验（Xu and Yan 2026；Jiang et al. 2026b）。因此，借助这类外化的引导知识，智能体能够更好地处理这些任务所涉及的长时程决策过程，而无需更新模型权重。早期技能库大多由人工编写，而近期研究则要求 LLM 智能体从先前轨迹中提取并改进技能，这通常称为技能自我演化（Zhou et al. 2026；Yang et al. 2026b；Zhang et al. 2026c）。Large language model (LLM)-based agents have emerged as a general paradigm for solving complex interaction tasks (Wang et al. 2024; Yao et al. 2023; Schick et al. 2023; Wang et al. 2023). To support this capability, external skill documents provide an important mechanism for injecting reusable procedures, tool-use knowledge, and task experience at execution time (Xu and Yan 2026; Jiang et al. 2026b). Consequently, with such externalized guiding knowledge, agents can better handle the long-horizon decision processes involved in these tasks without updating model weights. Early skill libraries were mostly hand-written, while recent works enforce the LLM agent to extract and refine skills from its prior trajectories, commonly called skill self-evolution (Zhou et al. 2026; Yang et al. 2026b; Zhang et al. 2026c).

早期技能自我演化方法通常采用顺序更新循环：每条新轨迹对当前技能编辑一次，然后流程继续处理下一条轨迹（Shinn et al. 2023；Madaan et al. 2023；Zhang et al. 2026b；Jiang et al. 2026a；Chen et al. 2026b）。这一过程很简单，但后续编辑往往带来的收益递减，同时会累积噪声或覆盖有用行为。Trace2Skill（Ni et al. 2026）将此过程重新构建为离线批处理流程：它从每条轨迹中提取一个技能补丁，再将这些补丁整合为更通用的技能修改。在这一范式基础上，SkillOpt（Yang et al. 2026a）将技能自我演化建模为梯度下降，并采用迭代优化进一步改进技能。总体而言，这些方法确立了一种范式：将智能体的执行历史提炼为可复用的技能更新。Early skill self-evolution methods usually follow a sequential update loop: each new trajectory edits the current skill once, and the pipeline then moves on to the next trajectory (Shinn et al. 2023; Madaan et al. 2023; Zhang et al. 2026b; Jiang et al. 2026a; Chen et al. 2026b). This procedure is simple, but later edits tend to yield diminishing returns, accumulating noise or overwriting useful behavior. Trace2Skill (Ni et al. 2026) recasts this process as an offline batch pipeline: it extracts one skill patch from each trajectory and then consolidates these patches into a more general skill edit. Building on this paradigm, SkillOpt (Yang et al. 2026a) models skill self-evolution as gradient descent and applies iterative optimization to further refine it. Overall, these methods establish a paradigm in which agents’ execution histories are distilled into reusable skill updates.

尽管取得了这些进展，随着任务复杂度上升且技能上下文增多，Trace2Skill 类流程仍面临三项挑战。(1) 单轨迹偏差：单条轨迹往往无法为某项任务提供有力证据；也就是说，成功轨迹可能只是反映了偶然采用的策略，而失败轨迹很少能揭示根本原因（Ni et al. 2026；Li et al. 2026b）。(2) 未经验证的合并：合并补丁前没有独立验证它们是否有益于源任务，因此低质量甚至有害的补丁可能进入技能语料库（Zhang et al. 2026a；Tian et al. 2026；Gou et al. 2024）。(3) 上下文过载：推理时向智能体输入无关或相互冲突的规则，增加推理开销并降低性能（Li et al. 2026a；Meng et al. 2026；Chen et al. 2026a）。Despite these advances, Trace2Skill-style pipelines still face three challenges as task complexity increases and the skill context grows. (1) Single-Trace Bias: a single trajectory often provides weak evidence for a task, i.e., a successful trace may reflect an accidental strategy, while a failed trace rarely reveals the root cause (Ni et al. 2026; Li et al. 2026b). (2) Unvalidated Merging: patches are merged without independently verifying whether they benefit the source task, so low-quality or even harmful patches may enter the skill corpus (Zhang et al. 2026a; Tian et al. 2026; Gou et al. 2024). (3) Context Overload: irrelevant or conflicting rules are fed into the agent during inference, increasing inference overhead and degrading performance (Li et al. 2026a; Meng et al. 2026; Chen et al. 2026a).

针对这些问题，我们提出对比式、评估增强且拓扑感知的技能自我演化方法（即 SkillCAT），将技能生命周期分解为三个可观测阶段，并为每个阶段引入针对性优化。对比因果提取（CCE）通过多随机种子采样为每项任务生成多条轨迹，构建同一任务的成功/失败对比对，并围绕结果之间的因果分界提取候选经验，而不是总结整条轨迹。评估增强演化（AAE）在源任务克隆上重放每个候选补丁，根据结果转变赋予校准分数，并仅保留能够改善或维持源任务行为的补丁供分层合并。拓扑感知任务执行（TTE）将演化后的技能编译为可路由的能力节点拓扑，并在推理时仅加载与任务相关的内容。由此，SkillCAT 通过以更有力的对比证据为技能修改提供依据、通过任务级验证筛选修改，以及在执行时仅呈现相关技能内容，来应对这三项挑战。In response to these problems, we propose a Contrastive, Assessment-Augmented, and Topology-Aware skill self-evolution (namely SkillCAT), which decomposes the skill lifecycle into three observable stages and introduces targeted optimizations for each. Contrastive Causal Extraction (CCE) generates multiple trajectories per task via multi-seed sampling and builds same-task success/failure contrastive pairs, extracting candidate experience around the causal watershed between outcomes rather than summarizing the full trace. Assessment-Augmented Evolution (AAE) replays each candidate patch on source-task clones, assigns calibrated scores based on outcome transitions, and retains only patches that improve or preserve source-task behavior for hierarchical merging. Topology-Aware Task Execution (TTE) compiles the evolved skill into a routable topology of capability nodes and loads only task-relevant content during inference. In this way, SkillCAT addresses the three challenges by grounding skill edits in stronger contrastive evidence, filtering them through task-level validation, and exposing only relevant skill content during execution.

在实证评估中，我们考察 SkillCAT 在同模型和跨模型技能使用设置下的表现。在同模型设置中，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 和 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 在智能体辅助的办公任务（例如电子表格操作）中分别同时充当技能编写者和技能使用者，演化后的技能还会在分布外（OOD）表格问答任务上接受测试。随后，我们评估技能向未见过的技能使用者迁移的情况，包括 Gemma-4-31B-it 和 GPT-5.4-mini，并评估多模态文档问答，其中 Qwen 编写的技能由两个 Qwen 使用者复用。在这些设置中，与初始技能相比，SkillCAT 的平均得分最高提升 49.69%。这些结果表明，面对较弱的技能初始化、未见过的任务领域以及不同的使用者模型时，SkillCAT 仍然稳健；消融研究也进一步证实，每个组件（CCE、AAE 和 TTE）都对最终提升有所贡献。Empirically, we evaluate SkillCAT under both same-model and cross-model skill-use settings. In the same-model setting, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B each act as both skill author and skill user on agent-assisted office tasks (e.g., spreadsheet manipulation), and the evolved skills are further tested on out-of-distribution (OOD) table question answering. We then evaluate transfer to unseen skill users, including Gemma-4-31B-it and GPT-5.4-mini, and assess multimodal document question answering with Qwen-authored skills reused by two Qwen users. Across these settings, SkillCAT improves the average score over the initial skill by up to 49.69%. These results indicate that SkillCAT remains robust across weaker skill initialization, unseen task domains, and different user models, and our ablation studies further confirm that every component (CCE, AAE, and TTE) contributes to the final improvement.

我们的贡献总结如下：We summarize our contributions as follows:

  • •

    我们指出了限制当前技能自我演化的三个实际问题：单轨迹偏差、未经验证的合并以及推理时上下文过载；这些问题共同导致性能不理想和推理效率低下。We identify three practical problems that limit current skill self-evolution: single-trace bias, unvalidated merging, and inference-time context overload, which together lead to suboptimal performance and inefficient inference.

  • •

    我们提出 SkillCAT，通过三个简单而有效的组件解决这些问题：同一任务的成功/失败对比提取、合并前的源任务重放，以及拓扑感知路由。We propose SkillCAT, which addresses these problems with three simple-yet-effective components: same-task success/failure contrastive extraction, source-task replay before merging, and topology-aware routing.

  • •

    在四个 LLM 智能体和三个智能体基准上的大量实验表明，与匹配的初始技能基线相比，SkillCAT 的平均得分最高提升 49.69%，显示出其有效性和通用性。Extensive experiments on four LLM agents and three agentic benchmarks show that SkillCAT improves the average score over matched initial-skill baselines by up to 49.69%, demonstrating its effectiveness and generality.

相关工作Related Work

面向 LLM 智能体的技能。Skill for LLM Agents.

智能体技能将可复用的任务工作流、工具使用策略和执行约束编码为外部制品，从而提供面向特定任务的指导（Wang et al. 2023；Zhou et al. 2026）。这类技能可以由人工编写或由模型生成，但仅仅拥有技能并不能保证任务性能更好。SkillsBench（Li et al. 2026b）发现，经过整理的技能通常有帮助，但自动生成的技能带来的收益并不一致。SkillLearnBench（Zhong et al. 2026）和 SkillFlow（Zhang et al. 2026c）进一步表明，持续更新可能发生漂移或退化。另有一类研究关注智能体如何从大型集合中选择和组合技能，例如 Graph of Skills（Li et al. 2026a）、SkillRAE（Meng et al. 2026）和 GraSP（Xia et al. 2026）。这些方法主要处理技能之间的检索与组合，通常假设有用的技能制品已经存在。我们的研究设定与之互补：我们不扩充技能库，而是将单个基础技能改进为更可靠的制品，并在测试时仅呈现该技能中与任务相关的部分。Agent skills encode reusable task workflows, tool-use strategies, and execution constraints as external artifacts, enabling task-specific guidance (Wang et al. 2023; Zhou et al. 2026). Such skills may be human-written or model-generated, yet their presence alone does not ensure better task performance. SkillsBench (Li et al. 2026b) finds that curated skills are generally helpful but automatically generated skills yield inconsistent gains. SkillLearnBench (Zhong et al. 2026) and SkillFlow (Zhang et al. 2026c) further show that continual updates can drift or regress. A separate line of work studies how agents select and compose skills from large collections, such as Graph of Skills (Li et al. 2026a), SkillRAE (Meng et al. 2026), and GraSP (Xia et al. 2026). These methods primarily address inter-skill retrieval and composition, typically assuming that useful skill artifacts already exist. Our setting is complementary: rather than expanding a skill library, we refine a single base skill into a more reliable artifact and expose only task-relevant parts of that same skill at test time.

技能自我演化。Skill Self-Evolution.

技能自我演化将执行经验转化为对外部技能的持久更新，而不修改骨干模型（Zhou et al. 2026）。例如，AutoSkill（Yang et al. 2026b）、XSkill（Jiang et al. 2026a）和 SkillClaw（Ma et al. 2026）分别将这一过程扩展到个性化、多模态和跨用户经验。在由执行驱动的技能演化研究中，代表性方法采用不同的更新策略，包括整合轨迹补丁、优化单份技能文档，以及迭代扩展和筛选技能集合。具体而言，Trace2Skill（Ni et al. 2026）从初始技能出发，从固定轨迹池中并行提取轨迹局部补丁，并将它们分层整合到单个技能目录中。SkillOpt（Yang et al. 2026a）将单份技能文档视为可训练的外部状态，把经评分的执行结果转换为有界的文档编辑，并且仅接受能够提升留出验证性能的更新。EvoSkill（Alzubi et al. 2026）遵循失败驱动的迭代演化方式，根据执行失败创建或修订技能，并使用留出验证来选择有希望的候选智能体配置。尽管这些方法有效，它们仍忽略了三个实际问题：证据来自彼此孤立的执行、补丁未经任务级效果检查便被整合，以及不加区分地加载完整技能。针对这些问题，SkillCAT 针对单个持续演化的技能，系统地整合同一任务的对比提取、源任务重放验证和拓扑感知路由，从而实现可靠改进和按任务选择部署。Skill self-evolution turns execution experience into persistent updates to external skills without modifying the backbone model (Zhou et al. 2026). For instance, AutoSkill (Yang et al. 2026b), XSkill (Jiang et al. 2026a), and SkillClaw (Ma et al. 2026) extend this process to personalized, multimodal, and cross-user experience, respectively. Within execution-driven skill evolution, representative methods adopt different update strategies, including consolidating trajectory patches, optimizing a single skill document, and iteratively expanding and selecting a skill set. Specifically, Trace2Skill (Ni et al. 2026) starts from an initial skill, extracts trajectory-local patches in parallel from a fixed trace pool, and hierarchically consolidates them into a single skill directory. SkillOpt (Yang et al. 2026a) treats a single skill document as trainable external state, converts scored rollouts into bounded document edits, and accepts only updates that improve held-out validation performance. EvoSkill (Alzubi et al. 2026) follows failure-driven iterative evolution, creating or revising skills from execution failures and using held-out validation to select promising candidate agent configurations. Despite their effectiveness, these methods still neglect three practical problems: evidence drawn from isolated executions, patches integrated without checking their task-level effect, and indiscriminate full-skill loading. In response to these problems, SkillCAT systematically integrates same-task contrastive extraction, source-task replay validation, and topology-aware routing for a single evolving skill, enabling reliable refinement and task-selective deployment.

方法Method

本节介绍 SkillCAT，它将技能自我演化分为三个阶段：对比因果提取（CCE）、评估增强演化（AAE）和拓扑感知任务执行（TTE）。值得注意的是，CCE 和 AAE 在技能学习期间离线运行，而 TTE 在任务部署期间在线运行。In this section, we introduce SkillCAT, which decomposes skill self-evolution into three stages: Contrastive Causal Extraction (CCE), Assessment-Augmented Evolution (AAE), and Topology-Aware Task Execution (TTE). Notably, CCE and AAE operate offline during skill learning, while TTE operates online during task deployment.

问题定义Problem Formulation

我们考虑一种技能自我演化设置：智能体获得一个基础技能 S0、一组演化任务 𝒳={x1,…,xN}，以及一组测试任务 𝒳∗={x1∗,…,xM∗}。通过多次执行每项任务，我们收集多样化的执行轨迹，并由官方评估器将每条轨迹标记为成功或失败。在 SkillCAT 中，离线阶段输出演化后的技能 S∗；在线执行阶段则针对每个测试任务 xj∗∈𝒳∗，从 S∗ 组装出路由技能 Sj。SkillCAT 的目标是在提升未见任务执行性能的同时，使注入智能体上下文的技能内容保持紧凑且与任务相关。We consider a skill self-evolution setting in which an agent is given a base skill S0, a set of evolution tasks 𝒳={x1,…,xN} and a set of test tasks 𝒳∗={x1∗,…,xM∗}. By executing each task multiple times, we collect diverse execution traces, each labeled as success or failure by the official evaluator. In SkillCAT, the offline stage outputs an evolved skill S∗, and the online execution stage assembles a routed skill Sj from S∗ for each test task xj∗∈𝒳∗. The objective of SkillCAT is to improve execution performance on unseen tasks while keeping the skill content injected into the agent context compact and task-relevant.

因此，我们的目标不只是将所有过去的执行轨迹总结为经验补丁并整合进 S0，从而生成一份全面的技能文档，而是让技能演化具有选择性。为此，SkillCAT 涉及：(1) 识别可靠的执行证据；(2) 验证哪些候选补丁应纳入演化后的技能；(3) 在执行期间仅呈现与任务相关的技能内容。图 2 和算法 1 总结了完整流程。CCE 从多随机种子轨迹中提取可靠的候选经验，AAE 通过源任务重放筛选并合并候选补丁，TTE 则组装具有可路由拓扑且与任务相关的技能。这三个模块分别对应证据获取、补丁验证与整合，以及测试时技能部署。Therefore, our goal is not merely to summarize all past execution traces into experience patches and integrate them into S0 to produce a comprehensive skill document, but to make skill evolution selective. To this end, SkillCAT involves (1) identifying reliable execution evidence, (2) validating which candidate patches should be incorporated into the evolved skill, and (3) exposing only task-relevant skill content during execution. Figure 2 and Algorithm 1 summarize the complete pipeline. CCE extracts reliable candidate experience from multi-seed trajectories, AAE filters and merges candidate patches via source-task replay, and TTE assembles a task-relevant skill with a routable topology. These three modules correspond to evidence acquisition, patch validation and integration, and test-time skill deployment, respectively.

对比因果提取（CCE）Contrastive Causal Extraction (CCE)

CCE 根据多随机种子运行结果构造同一任务的成功/失败轨迹对，并在二者出现有意义分歧之处提取技能证据。由于每对样本共享相同的输入、工具和评估器，提取出的证据可用于解释为何两种不同的执行选择会导致不同的执行结果。CCE forms same-task success/failure pairs from multi-seed runs and extracts skill evidence at the meaningful divergence between them. Since each pair of samples shares the same input, tools, and evaluator, the extracted evidence can be used to explain why two different execution choices lead to different execution results.

对比对构造。Contrastive pair construction.

对于任务 xi，我们使用不同随机种子进行多次运行。令 𝒯i+ 和 𝒯i− 分别表示成功轨迹集合和失败轨迹集合。当两个集合都非空时，CCE 会从每个集合中随机抽取一条轨迹，组成对比对 (τi+,τi−)。这种同任务配对能够隔离出区分成功与失败的关键行为。For task xi, we conduct multiple runs with different random seeds. Let 𝒯i+ and 𝒯i− denote the sets of successful and failed trajectories, respectively. When both sets are non-empty, CCE randomly samples one trajectory from each to form a contrastive pair (τi+,τi−). This same-task pairing isolates the critical behaviors that distinguish success from failure.

因果比较。Causal comparison.

给定一个对比对 (τi+,τi−)，CCE 会引导基于 LLM 的对比提取器 E 找出成功轨迹与失败轨迹中的动作序列开始分歧之处。随后，E 将这一分歧作为内部推理线索，撰写候选经验记录 ri，其中包括局部证据、失败原因以及可用于修改技能的经验教训。该过程可表示为：Given a contrastive pair (τi+,τi−), CCE guides an LLM-based contrastive extractor E to identify the point where the action sequences in the successful and failed traces diverge. Then E uses this divergence as an internal reasoning clue to write a candidate experience record ri, including local evidence, the cause of failure and a skill-editable lesson. This process can be formulated as:

ri=E⁡(τi+,τi−).r_{i}=E(\tau_{i}^{+},\tau_{i}^{-}).
(1)

不同于总结整条轨迹的现有方法（Ni et al. 2026；Alzubi et al. 2026），我们的候选经验记录聚焦于结果出现分歧时的行为差异。对于缺少对比结果的任务（即全部成功或全部失败），CCE 保留单轨迹流程以提取非对比记录。最后，技能编辑器将提取出的记录 ri 与基础技能 S0 结合，生成候选技能编辑补丁 pi，再将其交由 AAE 验证和合并。Unlike existing methods that summarize the full trace (Ni et al. 2026; Alzubi et al. 2026), our candidate experience record focuses on the behavioral difference where outcomes diverge. For tasks lacking contrastive outcomes (i.e., pure success or failure), CCE retains a single-trajectory pipeline to extract non-contrastive records. Finally, a skill editor combines the extracted record ri with the base skill S0 to generate candidate skill editing patch pi, which is then passed to AAE for validation and merging.

评估增强演化（AAE）Assessment-Augmented Evolution (AAE)

AAE 将每个候选补丁视为待验证的假设，而不是直接合并的规则。它将补丁隔离在临时技能中，在源任务上重放该技能，并在合并技能前为产生的结果转变评分。AAE treats each candidate patch as a hypothesis to be verified rather than a rule to be merged directly. It isolates the patch in a temporary skill, replays it on source-task, and scores the resulting outcome transition before skill merging.

补丁评估。Patch evaluation.

给定候选补丁 pi，AAE 会在相应的源任务克隆上重放由 pi 生成的临时技能，并记录原始结果和重放结果。为简洁起见，令 yi,y^i∈{0,1} 分别表示原始结果和重放结果，其中 1 表示成功，0 表示失败。AAE 直接对四种结果转变进行排序：Given a candidate patch pi, AAE replays the temporary skill induced by pi on the associated source-task clones and records both the original and replay outcomes. For simplicity, let yi,y^i∈{0,1} denote the original and replay outcomes, respectively, where 1 denotes success and 0 denotes failure. AAE ranks the four outcome transitions directly:

ai={3.0(yi,y^i)=(0,1),2.0(yi,y^i)=(1,1),1.0(yi,y^i)=(0,0),0.0(yi,y^i)=(1,0).a_{i}=\begin{cases}3.0&(y_{i},\hat{y}_{i})=(0,1),\\ 2.0&(y_{i},\hat{y}_{i})=(1,1),\\ 1.0&(y_{i},\hat{y}_{i})=(0,0),\\ 0.0&(y_{i},\hat{y}_{i})=(1,0).\end{cases}
(2)

该评分规则根据候选补丁如何改变源任务结果对其排序。失败→成功的转变得分最高，因为补丁修复了源任务；成功→成功则被接受，视为保留原有行为。失败→失败会被降权，而成功→失败则会被拒绝。This scoring rule ranks candidate patches by how they change the source-task outcome. The transition of (failure→success) receives the highest score, as the patch repairs the source task, whereas (success→success) is accepted as behavior preservation. The transition of (failure→failure) is downweighted, and (success→failure) is rejected.

分数引导的合并。Score-guided merge.

我们只合并分数高于阈值 θ 的补丁：We only merge patches whose scores are greater than the threshold θ:

𝒫θ={pi:ai≥θ},\mathcal{P}_{\theta}=\{p_{i}:a_{i}\geq\theta\},
(3)

在我们的工作中，θ=2.0。因此，保留的补丁要么修复源任务中的失败，要么保留已知的成功；而未能解决失败或将成功变为失败的补丁则会被排除在全局技能之外。where θ=2.0 in our work. Therefore, the retained patches either repair a source-task failure or preserve a known success, whereas patches that leave failures unresolved or turn successes into failures are excluded from the global skill.

阈值筛选后，AAE 将保留的补丁按分数分层，并从最低层到最高层依次合并。令 ℓ 表示合并层级索引，L 表示层级总数，𝒫θ(ℓ) 表示第 ℓ 层选出的补丁。令 μ 表示技能合并算子：After thresholding, AAE groups the retained patches into score tiers and merges them from the lowest tier to the highest. Let ℓ index the merge tier, L denote the number of tiers, and 𝒫θ(ℓ) denote the selected patches at tier ℓ. Let μ denote the skill-merge operator:

S(ℓ)=μ⁡(S(ℓ−1),𝒫θ(ℓ)),S^{(\ell)}=\mu\!\left(S^{(\ell-1)},\;\mathcal{P}_{\theta}^{(\ell)}\right),
(4)

其中 S(0)=S0，最终演化后的技能为 S∗=S(L)。这种顺序使得较高分数的补丁在后续阶段具有优先权，同时仍允许较低分但经过验证的补丁贡献彼此不冲突的规则。除了补丁筛选和合并顺序外，AAE 直接复用 Trace2Skill 的编辑流程，从反复出现的编辑中提取一般原则，而不是记忆实例特定的修正。where S(0)=S0 and the final evolved skill is S∗=S(L). This ordering gives higher-scoring patches priority in later stages, while still letting lower-scoring, validated ones contribute their non-conflicting rules. Besides patch selection and merge order, AAE directly reuses Trace2Skill’s edit procedure, extracting general principles from recurrent edits rather than memorizing instance-specific fixes.

拓扑感知任务执行（TTE）Topology-Aware Task Execution (TTE)

TTE 将测试时的技能使用视为上下文选择问题。它把演化后的技能 S∗ 编译成可路由拓扑，并针对每项任务组装出紧凑的路由技能 Sj，从而避免加载完整技能所带来的成本和干扰。TTE casts test-time skill use as a context-selection problem. It compiles the evolved skill S∗ into a routable topology and assembles a compact routed skill Sj for each task, avoiding the cost and distraction of loading the full skill.

拓扑构建。Topology construction.

TTE 将 AAE 生成的技能 S∗ 编译为核心技能 Sc 和一组能力节点 𝒱。对于每个节点，TTE 保留其原始正文 Bv 以供后续组装，并提取其标题、关键词、摘要和依赖关系作为路由元数据。节点元数据和依赖边共同构成紧凑的拓扑摘要 𝒢，其中边表示节点之间的流程依赖或工具使用依赖。因此，路由只读取 𝒢，而组装则访问所选节点的原始正文。TTE compiles the AAE-generated skill S∗ into a core skill Sc and a set of capability nodes 𝒱. For each node, TTE keeps the original body Bv for later assembly and extracts its title, keywords, summary, and dependencies as routing metadata. The node metadata and dependency edges form a compact topology summary 𝒢, in which edges denote procedural or tool-use dependencies between nodes. In this way, routing reads only 𝒢, whereas assembly accesses the original bodies of the selected nodes.

技能路由。Skill routing.

令 R 表示 LLM 路由器，A 表示 LLM 技能组装器。给定测试任务 xj∗ 和节点预算 k，R 从拓扑摘要 𝒢 中选择相关能力节点。Let R denote the LLM router and A denote the LLM skill assembler. Given a test task xj∗ and a node budget k, R selects relevant capability nodes from the topology summary 𝒢.

𝒱j=R⁡(xj∗,𝒢,k),|𝒱j|≤k.\mathcal{V}_{j}=R(x^{*}_{j},\mathcal{G},k),\qquad|\mathcal{V}_{j}|\leq k.
(5)

随后，组装器 A 根据核心技能和所选节点正文构建运行时技能 Sj。The assembler A then constructs the runtime skill Sj from the core skill and the selected node bodies.

Sj=A⁡(Sc,{Bv}v∈𝒱j).S_{j}=A\!\left(S_{c},\{B_{v}\}_{v\in\mathcal{V}_{j}}\right).
(6)

实验Experiments

实验设置Experimental Setup

数据集与评估。Datasets and Evaluation.

我们用于评估领域特定智能体技能的主要基准是 SpreadsheetBench-Verified，这是 SpreadsheetBench 中经人工验证的子集（Ma et al. 2024）。该子集包含来自现实世界 Excel 论坛的问题，涉及单元格级和工作表级的电子表格操作。遵循 Trace2Skill（Ni et al. 2026）和 SkillOpt（Yang et al. 2026a），我们将其中 400 个样本划分为 200 个演化样本和另外 200 个留出测试样本。评测协议在输入工作簿上执行解决方案，并将输出单元格与标准工作簿进行比较；只有所有答案都匹配时，任务才计为正确。为测试分布外（OOD）泛化能力，我们还在 WikiTableQuestions（Pasupat and Liang 2015，WikiTQ）上评估，该数据集是一个基于维基百科表格的半结构化表格问答基准；我们按照官方协议比较预测答案与标准答案的指称，并报告准确率。为测试多模态泛化能力，我们使用 DocVQA（Mathew et al. 2021）的官方验证集进行评估，该集合包含 5,349 个问题—图像对。前 2,700 个问题—图像对用于演化，其余 2,649 个用于评估；我们报告 ANLS（Mathew et al. 2021）和 Acc（ANLS ≥ 0.5）结果。为降低不确定性，结果取 3 个随机种子的平均值。Our primary benchmark for evaluating domain-specific agent skills is SpreadsheetBench-Verified, a human-validated subset of SpreadsheetBench (Ma et al. 2024). It contains real-world Excel forum questions covering cell- and sheet-level spreadsheet manipulation. Following Trace2Skill (Ni et al. 2026) and SkillOpt (Yang et al. 2026a), we split its 400 samples into 200 for evolution and the other 200 for held-out testing. The protocol executes the solution on the input workbook and compares output cells against the gold workbook, scoring a task as correct only when all answers match. To test out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, we also evaluate on WikiTableQuestions (Pasupat and Liang 2015) (WikiTQ), a semi-structured table QA benchmark over Wikipedia tables, comparing predicted and gold answer denotations under the official protocol and reporting accuracy. To test multimodal generalization, we evaluate on DocVQA (Mathew et al. 2021) using its official validation split, which contains 5,349 question–image pairs. The first 2,700 question-image pairs are used for evolution and the remaining 2,649 are for evaluation, and we report the ANLS (Mathew et al. 2021) and Acc (ANLS ≥ 0.5) results. To minimize uncertainty, our results are averaged over 3 random seeds.

基线与模型。Baseline and Models.

遵循 Ni et al.（2026），除 No-Skill 基线外，我们在两种基于技能的设置下评估 SkillCAT：1) Human-Written，从 Anthropic 的官方 xlsx 技能开始；2) LLM-Gen，从相应的基于 LLM 的技能编写模型生成的技能开始。在这两种设置下，我们将 SkillCAT 与三个先进的同类方法进行比较：Trace2Skill（Ni et al. 2026）、EvoSkill（Alzubi et al. 2026）和 SkillOpt（Yang et al. 2026a）。所有基线的完整细节见补充材料。与 Trace2Skill 类似，我们使用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 和 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B（Team 2026b）同时作为技能编写者和技能使用者。此外，在跨模型评估中，我们复用 Qwen 模型在 Human-Written 设置下演化出的技能，并在另外两个模型上进行评估，即 Gemma-4-31B-it（Team 2026a）和 GPT-5.4-mini（Singh et al. 2025）。Following Ni et al. (2026), in addition to the No-Skill baseline, we evaluate our SkillCAT under two skill-based settings: 1) Human-Written, which starts from Anthropic’s official xlsx skill; and 2) LLM-Gen, which starts from a skill generated by the corresponding LLM-based skill authors. In both settings, we compare SkillCAT against three cutting-edge counterparts: Trace2Skill (Ni et al. 2026), EvoSkill (Alzubi et al. 2026), and SkillOpt (Yang et al. 2026a). The full details of all baselines are provided in the supplementary material. Similar to Trace2Skill, we employ Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (Team 2026b) as both skill authors and skill users. Moreover, for cross-model evaluation, we reuse the skills evolved by the Qwen models under the Human-Written setting and evaluate them on two additional models, i.e., Gemma-4-31B-it (Team 2026a) and GPT-5.4-mini (Singh et al. 2025).

实现细节。Implementation Details.

所有智能体都在 ReAct 风格（Yao et al. 2023）的框架中运行，并配有文件系统和电子表格工具。具体而言，在 SkillCAT 中，CCE 为每个演化任务采样 5 个轨迹随机种子，以收集成功/失败证据。AAE 在源任务克隆上评估候选补丁，并在分层合并前仅保留 ai≥2.0 的补丁；TTE 使用图路由器，Top-k=7，随后注入特定于任务的技能。All agents run in a ReAct-style (Yao et al. 2023) harness with filesystem and spreadsheet tools. Specifically, in SkillCAT, CCE samples 5 trajectory seeds per evolution task to collect success/failure evidence. AAE evaluates candidate patches on source-task clones and keeps only patches with ai≥2.0 before hierarchical merging, and TTE uses the graph-based router with Top-k=7, followed by task-specific skill injection.

主要结果Main Results

SkillCAT 在领域内和分布外设置下均提升平均性能。SkillCAT improves average performance across in-domain and OOD settings.

表 1 的主要结果显示，在 Qwen 技能使用者与技能初始化方式的四种组合中，SkillCAT 都取得了最高的总体平均分，优于所有初始化基线和技能演化基线。它相较最强技能演化基线的最大优势，出现在使用 Human-Written 初始化的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 使用者上：在两位技能编写者和两项任务上取平均时，SkillCAT 达到 59.04%，而第二名 EvoSkill 为 42.21%，差距为 16.83%。在更强的 Human-Written 设置中，若 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 同时作为编写者和使用者，最强竞争方法因任务而异：在 SpreadsheetBench 上，Trace2Skill 领先 SkillCAT 0.66%；而在 WikiTQ 上，SkillCAT 领先最强竞争者 EvoSkill 0.32%。尽管任务级结果存在这些差异，SkillCAT 仍以 72.95% 获得最高的总体分数。这些较小的任务级差异可能是因为强初始技能本来就表现良好，因此可提升的空间相对有限。The main results in Table 1 show that SkillCAT achieves the highest overall average for all four combinations of Qwen skill user and skill initialization, outperforming all initialization and skill-evolution baselines. Its largest margin over the strongest skill-evolution baseline occurs for the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B user with Human-Written initialization: when averaged across the two skill authors and both tasks, SkillCAT reaches 59.04%, compared with 42.21% for the second-best (EvoSkill), a margin of 16.83%. In the stronger Human-Written setting with Qwen3.5-122B-A10B as both author and user, the strongest competing method differs by task: Trace2Skill leads SkillCAT by 0.66% on SpreadsheetBench, whereas SkillCAT leads the strongest WikiTQ competitor, EvoSkill, by 0.32%. Despite these task-level differences, SkillCAT retains the highest aggregate score at 72.95%. These small task-level differences may occur because the strong initial skill already performs well, leaving relatively little room for improvement.

SkillCAT 技能在未见过的使用者模型上无需重新演化即可提升平均表现。SkillCAT skills show average gains on unseen user models without re-evolution.

跨模型评估进一步检验这些提升是否来自可复用的技能内容，而不是编写者特有的行为。如表 1 所示，由任一 Qwen 编写者生成的技能，无需重新演化即可提升两种未见使用者的平均分：Gemma-4-31B-it 提升 11.23% 和 14.27%，GPT-5.4-mini 提升 7.14 和 7.22 个百分点。不过，任务级收益似乎取决于接收模型的基线表现。在 SpreadsheetBench 上，Gemma 在不使用技能时得分为 46.17%，SkillCAT 相对 Human-Written 分别提高 21.50 和 30.17 个百分点。在 WikiTQ 上，Gemma 的 No-Skill 得分已经达到 77.99%，而两个变体分别达到 77.67% 和 75.08%，相对 Human-Written 分别为 +0.97 和 −1.62 个百分点。这表明，当接收模型在任务上已经表现强劲时，跨模型技能带来的收益可能相对较小。The cross-model evaluation further tests whether the improvements stem from reusable skill content rather than author-specific behavior. As shown in Table 1, skills produced by either Qwen author improve the average score of both unseen users without re-evolution: by 11.23% and 14.27% for Gemma-4-31B-it and by 7.14 and 7.22 points for GPT-5.4-mini. However, task-level gains appear to depend on the recipient’s baseline performance. On SpreadsheetBench, where Gemma scores 46.17% without skills, SkillCAT gains 21.50 and 30.17 points over Human-Written. On WikiTQ, Gemma’s No-Skill score is already 77.99%, while the two variants reach 77.67% and 75.08%, or +0.97 and −1.62 points relative to Human-Written. This suggests that the benefits of cross-model skills maybe relatively small when the recipient has already performed strongly in the task.

SkillCAT 在多模态设置下持续取得提升。SkillCAT achieves consistent gains in multimodal settings.

多模态评估进一步证明了 SkillCAT 的有效性，并凸显了选择性合并补丁的好处。如图 3 所示，在两种使用者模型规模下，SkillCAT 相较 No-Skill 都持续取得显著提升。与 Trace2Skill 相比，SkillCAT 也展现出明显优势。对于匹配的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 使用者，SkillCAT 在两项指标上都优于 Trace2Skill。应用于更大的 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 使用者时，尽管两种方法的 ANLS 相近，SkillCAT 的准确率仍然更高。这种一致性表明，验证候选修改有助于避免噪声和近似匹配，从而产生质量更高、更精确的生成行为。The multimodal evaluation provides further evidence for the effectiveness of SkillCAT and underscores the benefits of selectively merging patches. As shown in Figure 3, SkillCAT consistently achieves substantial gains over No-Skill on both user model scales. Compared to Trace2Skill, SkillCAT also demonstrates a clear advantage. On the matched Qwen3.5-35B-A3B user, SkillCAT outperforms Trace2Skill in both metrics. When applied to the larger Qwen3.5-122B-A10B user, although both methods yield comparable ANLS, SkillCAT still ensures higher Accuracy. This consistency suggests that validating candidate edits helps prevent noisy, approximate matches and instead yields higher-quality, more precise generation behavior.

消融研究Ablation Study

表 2 报告了使用 Human-Written 初始化的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 消融结果，并以 Trace2Skill（29.67%）为参照。完整 SkillCAT 流程达到 55.00%（+25.33%），而每种移除一个组件的变体性能都下降，证实各模块彼此互补。具体而言，去掉 CCE 后，性能为 32.50%（+2.83%）。这是因为 AAE 可以筛选补丁，却无法恢复实现有效局部编辑所需的同任务对比信息。去掉 AAE 后，性能降至 26.00%（−3.67%），因为跳过重放验证和分数引导合并会将错误规则引入全局技能。TTE 可以进行路由，却无法纠正这些错误。因此，可靠的技能内容既需要对比证据，也需要补丁验证。相比之下，去掉 TTE、保留 CCE 和 AAE 时，仍能达到 46.50%（+16.83%）的性能提升。与完整流程之间的差距表明，路由通过抑制无关内容进一步改善了执行。单模块结果进一步印证了这种依赖关系。仅使用 CCE 和仅使用 AAE 时，得分分别为 39.00%（+9.33%）和 34.00%（+4.33%）；仅使用 TTE 时则为 27.50%（−2.17%）。这是因为路由既不会创建规则，也不会验证规则；对未经改进的技能进行固定 Top-k 选择会遗漏有用内容并选中错误规则。总之，CCE 改善编辑所依据的证据，AAE 验证候选编辑，TTE 则选择性部署演化后的技能。Table 2 reports the ablation of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with Human-Written initialization, using Trace2Skill (29.67%) as reference. The whole SkillCAT pipeline reaches 55.00% (+25.33%), while every leave-one-out variant declines, confirming that the modules are complementary. Specifically, without CCE, performance is 32.50% (+2.83%). This is because AAE can filter patches but cannot recover the same-task contrasts required for effective localized editing. Without AAE, performance falls to 26.00% (-3.67%), because bypassing replay validation and score-guided merging introduces error rules into the global skill. TTE can route but not correct these errors. Therefore, reliable skill content requires both contrastive evidence and patch validation. In contrast, when TTE is absent and CCE and AAE are retained, we still achieve 46.50% (+16.83%) performance improvement. The gap to the full pipeline shows that routing further improves execution by suppressing irrelevant content. The single-module results further reinforce this dependency. Only CCE and Only AAE reach 39.00% (+9.33%) and 34.00% (+4.33%), respectively, while Only TTE reaches 27.50% (-2.17%). This is because routing neither creates nor validates rules, and fixed Top-k selection over an unrefined skill would omit useful content and select error rules. Overall, CCE improves edit evidence, AAE validates candidate edits, and TTE selectively deploys the evolved skill.

更多分析More Analyses

CCE 需要多少条轨迹才能形成有用的对比对？How many trajectories does CCE need to form useful contrastive pairs?

图 4(a) 报告了每项任务采用不同数量轨迹时，SpreadsheetBench 留出集上的性能以及 CCE 阶段的推理时间。性能从使用 1 条轨迹时的 32.50% 上升到使用 5 条时的 55.00%，但在使用 7 条和 9 条时分别降至 46.00% 和 41.50%；与此同时，推理时间从 23 分钟增加到 282 分钟。这种下降表明，每项任务的轨迹池越大，其中包含的偶发失败越多。基于此类失败构造的成功/失败轨迹对会产生针对非必要行为而非任务关键行为的补丁，为演化后的技能增加噪声。因此，我们默认采样 5 条轨迹。Figure 4 (a) reports SpreadsheetBench held-out performance and CCE-stage inference time for different numbers of trajectories per task. Performance rises from 32.50% with one trajectory to 55.00% with five, but drops to 46.00% and 41.50% with seven and nine trajectories respectively, while inference time grows from 23 minutes to 282 minutes. This decline indicates that larger per-task pools include more incidental failures. Success/failure pairs built from such failures yield patches targeting unnecessary rather than task-critical behavior, adding noise to the evolved skill. Therefore, we sample five trajectories by default in our work.

是否有必要使用 AAE 过滤低奖励技能补丁？Is it necessary to filter out low-reward skill patches using AAE?

在 SkillCAT 中，AAE 不会将所有技能补丁合并为单个技能，而是衡量每个补丁的奖励（公式 2 中的 ai），并仅选择高奖励补丁进行合并。为考察不同奖励补丁的影响，我们首先构建四个补丁桶，每桶补丁数量相同但奖励不同，分别为 F→S（ai=3）、S→S（ai=2）、F→F（ai=1）和 S→F（ai=0），其中 F 和 S 分别表示失败和成功。由此得到四种技能，并将其用于后续 TTE 阶段。图 4(b) 展示了 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上的对比结果；我们观察到奖励与最终性能之间存在很强的相关性。具体而言，高奖励补丁（即 F→S 和 S→S）带来显著的性能提升，而低奖励补丁则只带来轻微提升（即 F→F）或导致性能下降（即 S→F）。因此，我们在工作中采用 F→S 和 S→S 补丁（即公式 3 中阈值 θ=2）。In our SkillCAT, instead of merging all skill patches into a single skill, AAE measures the reward (ai in Eq. 2) of each patch and selects only the high-reward ones for merging. Here, to investigate the effect of patches with different rewards, we first construct four patch buckets that contain the same number of patches but differ in reward, i.e., F→S (ai=3), S→S (ai=2), F→F (ai=1), and S→F (ai=0), where F and S denote failure and success, respectively. In this way, four skills are obtained and used for the subsequent TTE stage. The comparative results of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on SpreadsheetBench are presented in Figure 4 (b), from which we observe a strong correlation between the reward and the final performance. Specifically, high-reward patches (i.e., F→S and S→S) yield substantial performance gains, whereas low-reward patches yield either marginal improvements (i.e., F→F) or degrade performance (i.e., S→F). Thus, we use the F→S and S→S patches (i.e., threshold θ=2 in Eq. 3) in our work.

拓扑感知路由能否在减少推理上下文的同时提高准确率？Does topology-aware routing improve accuracy while reducing inference context?

如图 4(c) 所示，TTE 通过路由并仅保留最有效的上下文，成功释放了演化技能带来的更大收益。为筛选技能内容，我们设计了两种路由机制：基于图的路由器和基于嵌入的路由器。前者利用 LLM 分析技能内容构成的拓扑结构，随后选出最相关的 Top-k 个节点；后者则根据第三方 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B（Zhang et al. 2025）计算出的嵌入相似度检索 Top-k 个节点。在大多数预算设置下，两种路由器使用的 token 更少，且性能都高于这一参照。我们选择基于提示词的方法，因为它的性能具有竞争力，而且不依赖外部嵌入模型，从而避免引入额外的系统复杂性。As shown in Figure 4 (c), TTE successfully unleashes higher evolved-skill gains by routing and retaining only the most effective context. To filter skill content, we designed two routing mechanisms: a graph-based router and an embedding-based router. The former leverages the LLM to analyze the topological structure formed by skill content, subsequently selecting the Top-k most relevant nodes, while the latter retrieves the Top-k nodes based on embedding similarity computed by third-party Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (Zhang et al. 2025). Both routers stay above this reference for most budgets while using fewer tokens. We chose the prompt-based method because of its competitive performance and its independence from an external embedding model, which avoids introducing additional system complexity.

结论Conclusion

本文研究了现有 LLM 智能体技能自我演化方法的三项局限：单轨迹偏差、未经验证的合并和推理时上下文过载。SkillCAT 通过 CCE 提取同一任务的对比证据，通过 AAE 在源任务上重放来筛选候选补丁，并通过 TTE 仅加载与任务相关的技能内容，从而应对这些局限。为评估 SkillCAT 的有效性，我们在若干常用智能体基准上进行了评估，例如 SpreadsheetBench、WikiTableQuestions 和 DocVQA，同时考察其跨模型和 OOD 泛化能力。在这些条件下，SkillCAT 的平均得分相较可比基线最高提高 49.69 个百分点；消融实验和进一步分析也证实了各模块的贡献。This paper studies three limitations of existing skill self-evolution methods for LLM agents: single-trace bias, unvalidated merging, and inference-time context overload. SkillCAT addresses them by extracting same-task contrastive evidence with CCE, filtering candidate patches through source-task replay with AAE, and loading only task-relevant skill content through TTE. To assess the effectiveness of SkillCAT, we conducted evaluations on several popular agent benchmarks, such as SpreadsheetBench, WikiTableQuestions, and DocVQA, while also investigating its cross-model and OOD generalization. Under these conditions, SkillCAT outperforms comparable baselines by increasing the average score by up to 49.69 percentage points, while ablations and more analyses confirm the contribution of each module.
